---
description: Page and pageextension UI rules
applyTo: "**/Pages/**/*.al,**/*.Page.al,**/*.PageExt.al"
---

# Page and pageextension UI rules

- Prefer pageextension over copying standard pages.
- Keep controls/actions minimal, correctly placed, and consistent with the target page.
- Use captions, ToolTips, ApplicationArea, visibility/editability rules where applicable.
- Use sentence case for actionable text and title case for noun-based captions.
- Do not place reusable or complex business logic in page triggers.
